description.value: Cake It Easy is a family-owned boutique specializing in Filipino-inspired desserts, particularly ube-flavored cakes, sans rival, and bubble teas. The New Westminster location sits inside the Shops at New West mall at SkyTrain concourse level, making it a convenient stop for cyclists arriving by transit or passing through downtown New Westminster. Signature offerings include the Ube Flan Cake and Ube Rival Cake, with several gluten-free options available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the New Westminster location of Cake It Easy at 800 Carnarvon St #360, directly contradicting the OSM community tag of 'North Vancouver'; the url_discovery_notes also flag this. enrichment_extras.notes: This is one of two locations; the Vancouver store at 1211 Nanaimo St serves as the main production facility. Custom cakes can only be picked up from the Vancouver location.
